title: Discount Schedule to the Corporate Catering Service Agreement
content:
## Part A — standing discount

The standing discount is the negotiated discount on menu prices printed against the service level of the Corporate Catering Service Agreement.

| Service level | Standing discount |
| --- | --- |
| Drop-Off Catering Account | 0.0 per cent |
| Delivered Buffet Account | 1.5 per cent |
| Attended Buffet Account | 3.0 per cent |
| Staffed Full-Service Catering Account | 4.5 per cent |
| Executive Hospitality Catering Account | 5.0 per cent |
| Campus Catering Master Account | 6.5 per cent |

## Part B — volume discount ladder

The volume discount ladder printed against each service level maps trailing ninety-day catering spend, in USD, to an extra discount percentage. Three steps are printed against every level.

| Service level | Spend reaching 5000.00 USD | Spend reaching 15000.00 USD | Spend reaching 40000.00 USD |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Drop-Off Catering Account | 0.5 per cent | 1.0 per cent | 1.75 per cent |
| Delivered Buffet Account | 0.75 per cent | 1.5 per cent | 2.25 per cent |
| Attended Buffet Account | 1.0 per cent | 2.0 per cent | 3.0 per cent |
| Staffed Full-Service Catering Account | 1.25 per cent | 2.5 per cent | 3.75 per cent |
| Executive Hospitality Catering Account | 1.5 per cent | 2.75 per cent | 4.0 per cent |
| Campus Catering Master Account | 1.75 per cent | 3.25 per cent | 4.75 per cent |

Both parts of this schedule are figures printed against the service level. The standing discount recorded on an individual agreement is a separate record, held on the agreement itself.
